Wildfires in Spain, France Force Mass Evacuations

Wildfires have forced the evacuation of over 250,000 people in Spain and France, driven by heatwaves and dry conditions. In Spain, at least one death has been attributed to the blazes. Firefighters are battling numerous active fires, with some spreading rapidly towards populated areas like Bordeaux. Authorities have requested military assistance in France to help contain the fires.
